# @verevoir/recipes

Descriptor formats + zero-dependency parsers, plus the practices/capabilities
engine. A descriptor is a flat-frontmatter `.md`. Two kinds:
- a **recipe** (a.k.a. skill): a parameterised procedure (typed inputs →
  instructions → result) a host compiles to a chat-time tool, an MCP prompt, or
  runs inline;
- a **capability**: the data half of an outcome-shaped procedure — its
  postcondition and its edges (composition / follow-on), with optional tool
  inputs, gate, grants, and execution mode.

Plumbing only — the descriptor content lives in a project's corpus (e.g. a
guardrails repo) and is loaded at runtime; a different corpus is a different set
with no code change.

## Recipe (skill) format

`.md` with flat frontmatter (no YAML dep) + an instruction body:
- `id` (required, = filename stem), `name` (required), `description` (required)
- `tags`: inline list `[a, b]`
- `model_class`: `reasoning` (default) | `extraction`
- `inputs`: block list `- <name>: <type> (required) — <description>` (type defaults string)
- `output`: `<kind> — <description>`
- `handler`: present ⇒ deterministic code, not a reasoning prompt
- `agent`: optional A2A endpoint
- body after closing `---` = instructions

## Capability format

`.md` with flat frontmatter + an optional guidance body. Unrecognised keys are
ignored, so the format is forward-compatible.
- `type` (required, = filename stem), `postcondition` (required, "you will have …")
- `composes`: inline list — capabilities whose outcomes this one builds on
- `nextSteps`: inline list — candidate follow-on capabilities
- `grants`: inline list — tool permissions beyond the read-only floor (least
  permission; empty = read-only)
- `gate`: `none` (default) | `proposes` | `assent` — human-in-the-loop level for
  running the executor
- `execution`: `native` | `inline` | `compose` — how it runs (absent ⇒ the
  engine infers from `composes` / executors)
- `name`, `description`: tool display name + the description the model sees when
  the capability compiles to a conversation tool
- `inputs`: block list (same `- <name>: <type> (required) — <description>` shape
  as a recipe), present when the capability is a conversation tool
- `output`: free-text description of what it produces
- body after closing `---` = guidance (or, for `inline`, the prompt)

## API (root — `@verevoir/recipes`)

Parser only; zero runtime deps, no model adapter pulled in.

- `parseSkill(idHint, raw): SkillDescriptor` — throws `SkillParseError` on malformed input (no fence / missing required key / id≠filename).
- `isReasoningSkill(skill): boolean` — true when no `handler` (the ones worth exposing as prompts/inline tools).
- `renderSkillPrompt(skill, args): string` — instructions + supplied non-empty inputs, as the body a host model executes.
- `parseCapability(idHint, raw): CapabilityDescriptor` — throws `CapabilityParseError` on malformed input (no fence / missing required key / type≠filename).
- Recipe types: `SkillDescriptor`, `SkillInput` (`{name,type,required,description}`), `SkillInputType`, `SkillModelClass` (`'reasoning'|'extraction'`), `SkillParseError`.
- Capability types: `CapabilityDescriptor`, `CapabilityInput`, `CapabilityGate` (`'none'|'proposes'|'assent'`), `CapabilityExecution` (`'native'|'inline'|'compose'`), `CapabilityParseError`.

`CapabilityDescriptor` shape: `type`, `postcondition`, `composes` (string[]),
`nextSteps` (string[]), `grants` (string[]), `gate`, `execution?`, `name?`,
`description?`, `inputs` (CapabilityInput[]), `output?`, `guidance`.

## Engine (subpath — `@verevoir/recipes/engine`)

Separate export so parser-only consumers never load the model adapter
(`@verevoir/llm/anthropic`) or its `@anthropic-ai/sdk` peer. The engine over the
parsed descriptors:

- **Retrieval** — `buildCapabilityIndex`, `retrieveCapabilities(prose, corpus, embedder, k?)` (top-`k` advisory matches as `SurfacedCapability` `{type, summary}`), `cosine`, `addressingText`, `DEFAULT_K`; types `Embedder`, `CapabilityIndex`, `RetrievedCapability`, `SurfacedCapability`. The caller supplies the embedder — recipes bundles none.
- **Provisioning** — `provisionPractices`, `selectConcernTags` (concern-tagging; takes an optional `chat: ChatFn` defaulting to Anthropic, so it runs on any `@verevoir/llm` provider), `parseConcernTags`, `findPractices`, `declaredConcernsOf`; constants `FOUNDATIONAL`, `CONCERN_MENU`, `CONCERN_PRACTICES`; types `Concern`, `ProvisionInput`, `ChatFn`.
- **Planning** — `planExecution`, `buildPlanGraph`, `selectEntryCapabilities`, `parseSelectedIds`, `NARROW_SYSTEM_PROMPT`; types `PlanNode`, `ExecutionPlan`, `PlanDeps`.

## Consumers

The aigency web app (compiles recipes to chat tools, runs the engine) and
`@verevoir/mcp` (exposes reasoning recipes as MCP prompts; `provision` /
capability surfacing drive the engine) parse with this one library — one
descriptor format, many surfaces.

## Notes

- ESM only, Node >= 20. Apache-2.0.
- Recipe function/type names keep the `Skill*` prefix (AOA origin); the package
  is `recipes` to avoid colliding with the host *capability* concept.
- `@verevoir/llm` + `@anthropic-ai/sdk` are optional peers — needed only for the
  engine's reasoning calls, never for the root parser.
